verdict.rationale: The CRA documents sanctioned third-party channels. Representatives request online account access through the Represent a Client portal, and the e-services include authorizing access to online information and filing or paying for business clients. EFILE separately sets out an enrolled-filer and certified-software path for transmitting returns on clients' behalf. Missing for 10: detail on how a business grants, scopes and revokes representative authorization; the EFILE evidence covers individual (T1) returns rather than business filings; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
